Classifiers, on the other hand, are used to classify data into different categories or classes. They are often used in machine learning tasks such as image recognition, speech recognition, and natural language processing. Classifiers work by learning a set of rules or patterns that can be used to classify new data into one of several categories. They are often trained using large datasets of labeled data and can be used to classify new data into one of several categories.

In summary, language models are used for predicting the next word or phrase in a sequence of words, while classifiers are used for classifying data into different categories or classes.
